items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Reuben Roddy was the main tenor, and he didn't play no solo.

ctx.x: Why was it decided to hire him?

Well, we didn't have no tenor player to get (?). We didn't have no hot tenor player. Reuben Roddy was the main tenor, and he didn't play no solo. No, we didn't have no tenor player at all. See, during them days, tenor players was very popular...
I mean, were you sorry that you couldn't find a tenor player that sounded like Coleman Hawkins?
